title: An item whose touches name a .claude link to the plugin's sprint files cannot land its change, which git records at the plugin path
goal: done, held and the plan's overlap warnings treat a touch of .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md, kb-item, kb-backlog or .claude/agents/kb-worker.md as a touch of the plugin file the link resolves to (or check rewrites such touches), so the open items that name the link paths land

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_base; sys.exit(0 if bl_base.in_scope('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', ['.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md']) else 1)

notes: Review gap 1: 37 open items (e.g. ST-77goqrxz, ST-a5q6vaji, ST-jv27pfin, ST-ifljijni) name the link paths in touches; an edit through the link shows in git as skills/sprint/SKILL.md, and in_scope('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', ['.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md']) is False, so done refuses it as outside the touches. Workaround until fixed: set ID --add-touch skills/sprint/SKILL.md (or the matching plugin file). Recurred at SP-x5gjv4r7 (2026-10-10): ST-ylje2dxh, ST-ifljijni and ST-mti4zrzz named .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md; the orchestrator added skills/sprint/SKILL.md to each item's touches by hand before landing.
